column1: # Glacier ice (Terrain, 11-04, Ronald "all three"): the floor of high glacier valleys. Opaque. Each image: a default and 3 variants of one face for a ctm random set (like the rocks); _vN are cut to glacier_ice_<face>/N.png.

column3: glacier_ice_top|cube|Glacier ice seen from above: compacted opaque pale blue-white ice (#a9c4d8 #bcd4e6 #cfe1ee #e2eef6 #f2f8fb), smooth, with a few faint fine cracks and small trapped air bubbles, slightly brighter patches of frosted snow, no strong pattern, seamless
column4: glacier_ice_top_v1@-|cube|The same glacier ice top, variant 2: the same colours and texture, different crack and bubble places, seamless
column5: glacier_ice_top_v2@-|cube|The same glacier ice top, variant 3: the same colours, one longer faint crack across, different bubbles, seamless
column6: glacier_ice_top_v3@-|cube|The same glacier ice top, variant 4: the same colours, a faint frosted patch, different places, seamless

column3: glacier_ice_side|cube|Glacier ice seen from the side: compacted opaque blue-white ice in faint horizontal layers (#8fb0c8 #a9c4d8 #bcd4e6 #cfe1ee #e2eef6), 3-4 gently wavy bands of slightly different blue, a thin darker dusty band (#7f98ac), small air streaks stretched sideways, seamless left to right
column4: glacier_ice_side_v1@-|cube|The same glacier ice side, variant 2: the same colours and layered look, the bands at the same heights but wavier differently, different air streaks, seamless
column5: glacier_ice_side_v2@-|cube|The same glacier ice side, variant 3: the same colours, the bands at the same heights, a fine vertical crack, different air streaks, seamless
column6: glacier_ice_side_v3@-|cube|The same glacier ice side, variant 4: the same colours, the bands at the same heights, more bubbles, seamless
